description: The file defines API routes related to payment processing in a FastAPI-based backend. It includes endpoints for creating mock payment intents and a webhook placeholder for payment provider notifications. It interacts with database models such as Order and PaymentStatus, and utilizes dependency injection for database sessions and user role validation.

methods.name: PaymentIntentResponse create_payment_intent( payload: PaymentIntentRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )
methods.description: Creates a mock payment intent for an order, validating order existence and user authorization, then returning a fake client secret.

methods.name: dict payment_webhook()
methods.description: Endpoint placeholder for payment provider webhooks, currently returns a simple accepted status and provider info.
